PROJECTS.title: Economic Research Agent (Agent Garden) 📈
PROJECTS.description: Production multi-tool ADK 2.0 agent bridging natural language macro-economic inquiries with live FRED, US Census, and HUD real estate APIs.
highlights: Zero Math Drift & Zero Hallucination: Delegates all statistical calculations, yield ratios, and time-series aggregations to deterministic Python tools.
Obscure Identifier Resolution: Automatically resolves human metro/county names into exact 5-digit FIPS codes, HUD Fair Market Rent IDs, and FRED series tickers.
Live Multi-Source Synthesis: Combines Federal Reserve (FRED) interest/inflation rates, Census ACS demographics, and HUD rent benchmarks in a single turn.

details.strategy: LLMs notoriously hallucinate economic statistics and fail when APIs require obscure geographic identifiers like FIPS codes. We solved this with a two-stage semantic resolver and deterministic calculation harness in ADK 2.0.
